organization_connection_attempts_shape_c.name: organization_connection_attempts_shape_check
organization_connection_attempts_shape_c.value:
("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'github_setup' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'github' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is null and "organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is null)
        or ("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'github_user_authorization' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'github' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is not null and ("organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is not null or "organization_connection_attempts"."consumed_at" is not null))
        or ("organization_connection_attempts"."phase" = 'discord_authorization' and "organization_connection_attempts"."provider" = 'discord' and "organization_connection_attempts"."candidate_external_id" is null and "organization_connection_attempts"."pkce_verifier" is null)

triggers_organization_or_dropped_check.name: triggers_organization_or_dropped_check
triggers_organization_or_dropped_check.value: "triggers"."organization_id" is not null or "triggers"."dropped_reason" is not null
